## NSF Undergraduate Researcher, Michigan State University {#msu-research}

```{=html}
<div class="project">
  <div class="project-img">
    <img src="https://placehold.co/400x300?text=Photo+Coming+Soon" alt="Semiconductor materials research">
  </div>
  <div class="project-text">
    <p><strong>Department of Materials Engineering, East Lansing, MI</strong> &nbsp;|&nbsp; June 2026 – September 2026</p>
    <p><strong>Overview:</strong><br>
      I researched semiconductor materials, screening earth-abundant semiconductors for photocatalytic
      water-splitting. I extended SALSA, a GitHub-hosted materials-discovery pipeline, with automated
      convex-hull stability analysis, and validated thermodynamic stability across four levels of theory
      (OPT2, SP, enthalpy, and Gibbs free energy).</p>
    <p>I also consolidated about 20 separate scripts into one Python suite for AFLOW and Materials
      Project scraping, CIF generation, CRYSTAL23 parsing, and hull plotting. This cut manual analysis
      from days to hours.</p>
    <p><strong>Skills:</strong><br>
      Python, Computational Materials Science, AFLOW, Materials Project, CRYSTAL23, Data Pipelines</p>
  </div>

```
